definitions.twelfth_from_ketu: The sign immediately BEFORE Ketu's sign in normal zodiac order (count forward normally, NOT in reverse). E.g. Ketu in Kanni -> 12th is Simha. It is also the sign Ketu transits into next, since nodes move retrograde.
trigger_modes: OCCUPANT: planet X is placed in the 12th sign from Ketu
SIGN_LORD: the 12th sign from Ketu is owned by planet X (i.e. Ketu sits in the sign right after X's sign)
definitions.reference: Independent of Lagna and Rasi - only Ketu's sign matters.
definitions.strength_modifier: Many results flip between positive and negative expression depending on whether X is strong (own/exalted, Guru aspect, sthana bala, good nakshatra lord) or weak.

general_principles.condition: Ketu in house 3, 6 or 11 from Lagna
general_principles.result: Generally yogic (same for Rahu). Not absolute - Ketu in 11 can still harm, Ketu in 8 can still give big success.
Results of the NEXT sign Ketu will move into (house H-1, i.e. 12th from Ketu) get suppressed first and delivered later.
general_principles.example: Ketu in 8th from Lagna -> marriage delayed because Ketu's next move is into the 7th, not because it sits in the 8th.

general_principles.result: Strong spiritual inclination, pilgrimage, temple service, charity, A young native may not show it yet, it emerges with life experience.
Extreme outcomes - either very large gains or very severe fall, depending on Ketu's placement quality.
